vsm2.20:76.1: Yaṃ pana vuttaṃ ‘‘arūpasattakavasenā’’ti, tattha ayaṃ mātikā –
vsm2.20:76.2: kalāpato, yamakato, khaṇikato, paṭipāṭito, diṭṭhiugghāṭanato, mānasamugghāṭanato, nikantipariyādānatoti.
vsm2.20:77.2: Kathaṃ kalāpato sammasatīti? Idha bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati –
vsm2.20:77.3: ‘‘ye ime ‘kesā aniccā dukkhā anattā’ti sammasane uppannā phassapañcamakā dhammā, ye ca ‘lomā…pe… matthaluṅgaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’ti sammasane uppannā phassapañcamakā dhammā,
vsm2.20:77.4: sabbe te itarītaraṃ appatvā pabbaṃpabbaṃ odhiodhi hutvā tattakapāle pakkhittatilā viya taṭataṭāyantā vinaṭṭhā, tasmā aniccā dukkhā anattā’’ti.
vsm2.20:78.1: Ariyavaṃsakathāyaṃ pana ‘‘heṭṭhā rūpasattake sattasu ṭhānesu ‘rūpaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’ti pavattaṃ cittaṃ aparena cittena ‘aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’ti sammasanto ‘kalāpato sammasatī’ti’’ vuttaṃ,
vsm2.20:78.2: taṃ yuttataraṃ. Tasmā sesānipi teneva nayena vibhajissāma.
vsm2.20:79.1: Yamakatoti idha bhikkhu ādānanikkheparūpaṃ ‘‘aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti sammasitvā tampi cittaṃ aparena cittena ‘‘aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti sammasati.
vsm2.20:79.2: Vayovuḍḍhatthaṅgamarūpaṃ, āhāramayaṃ, utumayaṃ, kammajaṃ, cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ, dhammatārūpaṃ ‘‘aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti sammasitvā tampi cittaṃ aparena cittena ‘‘aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti sammasati.
vsm2.20:80.1: Khaṇikatoti idha bhikkhu ādānanikkheparūpaṃ ‘‘aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti sammasitvā taṃ paṭhamacittaṃ dutiyacittena, dutiyaṃ tatiyena, tatiyaṃ catutthena, catutthaṃ pañcamena ‘‘etampi aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti sammasati.
vsm2.20:80.2: Vayovuḍḍhatthaṅgamarūpaṃ, āhāramayaṃ, utumayaṃ, kammajaṃ, cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ, dhammatārūpaṃ ‘‘aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti sammasitvā taṃ paṭhamacittaṃ dutiyacittena, dutiyaṃ tatiyena, tatiyaṃ catutthena, catutthaṃ pañcamena ‘‘etampi aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti sammasati.
vsm2.20:80.3: Evaṃ rūpapariggāhakacittato paṭṭhāya cattāri cattāri cittāni sammasanto khaṇikato sammasati nāma.
vsm2.20:81.1: Paṭipāṭitoti ādānanikkheparūpaṃ ‘‘aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti sammasitvā taṃ paṭhamacittaṃ dutiyacittena, dutiyaṃ tatiyena, tatiyaṃ catutthena…pe… dasamaṃ ekādasamena ‘‘etampi aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti sammasati.
vsm2.20:81.2: Vayovuḍḍhatthaṅgamarūpaṃ, āhāramayaṃ, utumayaṃ, kammajaṃ, cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ, dhammatārūpaṃ ‘‘aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti sammasitvā taṃ paṭhamacittaṃ dutiyacittena, dutiyaṃ tatiyena, tatiyaṃ catutthena…pe… dasamaṃ ekādasamena ‘‘etampi aniccaṃ dukkhamanattā’’ti
vsm2.20:81.3: evaṃ vipassanā paṭipāṭiyā sakalampi divasabhāgaṃ sammasituṃ vaṭṭeyya.
vsm2.20:81.4: Yāva dasamacittasammasanā pana rūpakammaṭṭhānampi arūpakammaṭṭhānampi paguṇaṃ hoti.
vsm2.20:82.1: Diṭṭhiugghāṭanato mānaugghāṭanato nikantipariyādānatoti imesu tīsu visuṃ sammasananayo nāma natthi.
vsm2.20:82.2: Yaṃ panetaṃ heṭṭhā rūpaṃ, idha ca arūpaṃ pariggahitaṃ, taṃ passanto rūpārūpato uddhaṃ aññaṃ sattaṃ nāma na passati.
vsm2.20:82.3: Sattassa adassanato paṭṭhāya sattasaññā ugghāṭitā hoti.
vsm2.20:82.4: Sattasaññaṃ ugghāṭitacittena saṅkhāre pariggaṇhato diṭṭhi nuppajjati.
vsm2.20:82.5: Diṭṭhiyā anuppajjamānāya diṭṭhi ugghāṭitā nāma hoti.
vsm2.20:82.7: Māne anuppajjante māno samugghāṭito nāma hoti.
vsm2.20:82.9: Taṇhāya anuppajjantiyā nikanti pariyādiṇṇā nāma hotīti idaṃ tāva visuddhikathāyaṃ vuttaṃ.
vsm2.20:83.1: Ariyavaṃsakathāyaṃ pana ‘‘diṭṭhiugghāṭanato mānasamugghāṭanato nikantipariyādānato’’ti mātikaṃ ṭhapetvā ayaṃ nayo dassito.
vsm2.20:83.2: ‘‘Ahaṃ vipassāmi, mama vipassanā’’ti gaṇhato hi diṭṭhisamugghāṭanaṃ nāma na hoti.
vsm2.20:83.3: ‘‘Saṅkhārāva saṅkhāre vipassanti sammasanti vavatthapenti pariggaṇhanti paricchindantī’’ti gaṇhato pana diṭṭhiugghāṭanaṃ nāma hoti.
vsm2.20:83.4: ‘‘Suṭṭhu vipassāmi, manāpaṃ vipassāmī’’ti gaṇhato mānasamugghāṭo nāma na hoti.
vsm2.20:83.5: ‘‘Saṅkhārāva saṅkhāre vipassanti sammasanti vavatthapenti pariggaṇhanti paricchindantī’’ti gaṇhato pana mānasamugghāṭo nāma hoti.
vsm2.20:83.6: ‘‘Vipassituṃ sakkomī’’ti vipassanaṃ assādentassa nikantipariyādānaṃ nāma na hoti.
vsm2.20:83.7: ‘‘Saṅkhārāva saṅkhāre vipassanti sammasanti vavatthapenti pariggaṇhanti paricchindantī’’ti gaṇhato pana nikantipariyādānaṃ nāma hoti.
vsm2.20:84.1: Sace saṅkhārā attā bhaveyyuṃ, attāti gahetuṃ vaṭṭeyyuṃ, anattā ca pana attāti gahitā,
vsm2.20:84.2: tasmā te avasavattanaṭṭhena anattā, hutvā abhāvaṭṭhena aniccā, uppādavayapaṭipīḷanaṭṭhena dukkhāti passato diṭṭhiugghāṭanaṃ nāma hoti.
vsm2.20:85.1: Sace saṅkhārā niccā bhaveyyuṃ, niccāti gahetuṃ vaṭṭeyyuṃ, aniccā ca pana niccāti gahitā,
vsm2.20:85.2: tasmā te hutvā abhāvaṭṭhena aniccā, uppādavayapaṭipīḷanaṭṭhena dukkhā, avasavattanaṭṭhena anattāti passato mānasamugghāṭo nāma hoti.
vsm2.20:86.1: Sace saṅkhārā sukhā bhaveyyuṃ, sukhāti gahetuṃ vaṭṭeyyuṃ, dukkhā ca pana sukhāti gahitā,
vsm2.20:86.2: tasmā te uppādavayapaṭipīḷanaṭṭhena dukkhā, hutvā abhāvaṭṭhena aniccā, avasavattanaṭṭhena anattāti passato nikantipariyādānaṃ nāma hoti.
vsm2.20:86.3: Evaṃ saṅkhāre anattato passantassa diṭṭhisamugghāṭanaṃ nāma hoti.
vsm2.20:86.6: Iti ayaṃ vipassanā attano attano ṭhāneyeva tiṭṭhatīti.
vsm2.20:88.1: Evaṃ arūpasattakavasenāpi tilakkhaṇaṃ āropetvā saṅkhāre sammasati.
vsm2.20:88.2: Ettāvatā panassa rūpakammaṭṭhānampi arūpakammaṭṭhānampi paguṇaṃ hoti.
vsm2.20:89.2: yā upari bhaṅgānupassanato paṭṭhāya pahānapariññāvasena sabbākārato pattabbā aṭṭhārasa mahāvipassanā,
vsm2.20:89.3: tāsaṃ idheva tāva ekadesaṃ paṭivijjhanto tappaṭipakkhe dhamme pajahati.
vsm2.20:91.1: Tāsu yasmā iminā aniccādilakkhaṇattayavasena saṅkhārā diṭṭhā,
vsm2.20:91.3: Yasmā ca ‘‘yā ca aniccānupassanā yā ca animittānupassanā, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanameva nānaṃ’’.
vsm2.20:91.4: Tathā ‘‘yā ca dukkhānupassanā yā ca appaṇihitānupassanā, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanameva nānaṃ’’.
vsm2.20:91.5: ‘‘Yā ca anattānupassanā yā ca suññatānupassanā, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanameva nāna’’nti (paṭi. ma. 1.227) vuttaṃ.
vsm2.20:91.10: Sesesu vipassanāñāṇesu kiñci paṭividdhaṃ, kiñci appaṭividdhaṃ, tesaṃ vibhāgaṃ parato āvikarissāma.
vsm2.20:92.1: Yadeva hi paṭividdhaṃ, taṃ sandhāya idaṃ vuttaṃ
vsm2.20:92.2: ‘‘evaṃ paguṇarūpārūpakammaṭṭhāno yā upari bhaṅgānupassanato paṭṭhāya pahānapariññāvasena sabbākārato pattabbā aṭṭhārasa mahāvipassanā.
vsm2.20:92.3: Tāsaṃ idheva tāva ekadesaṃ paṭivijjhanto tappaṭipakkhe dhamme pajahatī’’ti.
